entities.name: Decline & Ottoman Conquest
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Internal fragmentation, Mongol vassalage, and the rise of independent boyars weakened Bulgaria. The Ottoman Turks captured Adrianople (1362), defeated the Bulgarians at the Battle of Nicopolis (1396), and extinguished the Second Empire.
